scope: purged validation 2021-2022 only; smoke excluded; no new-model test outputs read

design.scope: full purged validation, no test labels or metrics
design.purpose: matched independent Gaussian / one-component control; component counts and gate inputs; separately recorded excess-return targets
design.queue_status: 18 full candidates prioritized; extra one-component excess-target controls distinguish architecture from target changes

notes: All ranking and portfolio metrics use the unchanged baseline framework.
Density diagnostics use observed validation returns and CPU float32 forecasts; densities of different target kinds are not directly comparable.
One-component float64 mixture control isolates component count; legacy Gaussian has the same initial parameters but float32 likelihood arithmetic.
No evidence here establishes exceeding any holdout baseline envelope.

cpu_checks.scope: CPU regression tests; actual GPU and complete baseline evaluation checked separately

gpu_recovery.scope: GPU smoke continuation and exhausted-epoch recovery; excluded from full validation counts
gpu_recovery.replay_change: fresh output directory per invocation; training and equality checks unchanged
